thread:
Ivy: Deployment finished for release/optimizations-v3. Rolling traffic now. Can folks run quick smoke checks? I'll be on-call for rollback until 11:30 PDT.
Noah: on it. I'll validate API surface and run a couple of perf queries. ETA 5m.
Priya: I'll check embeddings pipeline + e2e job queue. ping me if you see SLO blips.
Sam: I'll watch the dashboards and do a few sample requests from the staging cluster.
deploy-bot: CI: all post-deploy checks passed (unit, integration). Canary 30% → 100% completed.
Marta: Quick checklist I'm using: 
- health endpoint 
- sample generation correctness 
- latency P95 under 200ms for baseline routes 
- no spike in 5xx or QPS drop in upstreams
Noah: Running health curl: ```bash
curl -sS -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/health | jq .status
```
Noah: health returned "ok" for all nodes.
Priya: Ran a sample embedding job and compared top-3 nearest results vs baseline — looks unchanged.
Sam: Observability: Prometheus query for request errors I'm watching: ```promql
sum(increase(http_requests_total{job="inference",code=~"5.."}[5m]))
```
Sam: 5m error rate is 0 -> stable. Latency P95 graph shows a tiny bump during rollout but back to normal now.
Marta: Verified downstream queue length for offline batches: no backlog.
Ivy: Thanks. Can someone also run a couple of short multi-turn chats to validate KV-cache correctness?
Noah: Doing that now. sample chat -> no repetition issues, tokens look right.
Priya: FYI I saw one warning in the worker logs about an unexpected tensor shape during cold start, but it auto-recovered. Pasted snippet: ```
WARN model-loader: shape mismatch for layer embedding, attempted fallback to fp16 quantized.
```
Marta: That warning showed on two warmups but didn't affect outputs. I'll open a follow-up ticket to track.
Ivy: Good catch. For rollback readiness: ops-oncall, do we have the previous model snapshot pinned and scripts ready?
ops-oncall: Yep — rollback playbook updated, snapshot tag release/optimizations-v2 available in registry. Rollback test run succeeded in staging earlier.
ops-oncall: I'll keep monitoring infra for 30m and will trigger rollback if error rate > 0.5% sustained for 10m or P95 > 400ms.
Sam: Noted. I've added a temporary alert on the release channel if thresholds cross.
Marta: Small follow-up fix I can push if teams see minor tokenization drift — low-risk change. Should we schedule a patch window later today?
Ivy: Let's wait 2 hours and reconvene. If all clear, no patch. If any regression, we roll back immediately and schedule patch. Thanks everyone — marking this thread for post-deploy notes. :white_check_mark:
